name: session_user_platform_active_refresh
sql: SELECT id,user_id,platform,refresh_expires_at FROM user_sessions WHERE user_id=:user_id AND platform=:platform AND is_del=2 AND revoked_at IS NULL AND refresh_expires_at>:now ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT :limit
row_distribution_sql: SELECT platform,is_del,COUNT(*) rows_count FROM user_sessions GROUP BY platform,is_del ORDER BY platform,is_del

name: conversation_user_cursor
sql: SELECT id,user_id,agent_id,last_message_at FROM ai_conversations WHERE user_id=:user_id AND is_del=2 AND (last_message_at<:before_time OR (last_message_at=:before_time AND id<:before_id)) ORDER BY last_message_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT :limit
row_distribution_sql: SELECT user_id,is_del,COUNT(*) rows_count FROM ai_conversations GROUP BY user_id,is_del ORDER BY rows_count DESC,user_id
proposed_index: CREATE INDEX idx_ai_conversations_user_active_last ON ai_conversations (user_id,is_del,last_message_at DESC,id DESC)

name: conversation_user_agent_cursor
sql: SELECT id,user_id,agent_id,last_message_at FROM ai_conversations WHERE user_id=:user_id AND agent_id=:agent_id AND is_del=2 AND (last_message_at<:before_time OR (last_message_at=:before_time AND id<:before_id)) ORDER BY last_message_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT :limit
row_distribution_sql: SELECT user_id,agent_id,is_del,COUNT(*) rows_count FROM ai_conversations GROUP BY user_id,agent_id,is_del ORDER BY rows_count DESC,user_id,agent_id
proposed_index: CREATE INDEX idx_ai_conversations_user_agent_del_last_message ON ai_conversations (user_id,agent_id,is_del,last_message_at DESC,id DESC)

name: ai_run_status_started
sql: SELECT id,status,started_at FROM ai_runs WHERE status=:status AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at<:before_time ORDER BY started_at ASC,id ASC LIMIT :limit
row_distribution_sql: SELECT status,COUNT(*) rows_count FROM ai_runs GROUP BY status ORDER BY rows_count DESC,status

name: ai_run_platform_created
sql: SELECT id,platform,created_at FROM ai_runs WHERE platform=:platform AND (created_at<:before_time OR (created_at=:before_time AND id<:before_id)) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT :limit
row_distribution_sql: SELECT platform,COUNT(*) rows_count FROM ai_runs GROUP BY platform ORDER BY rows_count DESC,platform
proposed_index: CREATE INDEX idx_ai_runs_platform_created ON ai_runs (platform,created_at DESC,id DESC)

name: payment_order_provider_status_updated
sql: SELECT id,order_no,status,updated_at FROM payment_orders WHERE provider=:provider AND status=:status AND is_del=2 AND (updated_at<:before_time OR (updated_at=:before_time AND id<:before_id)) ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT :limit
row_distribution_sql: SELECT provider,status,is_del,COUNT(*) rows_count FROM payment_orders GROUP BY provider,status,is_del ORDER BY rows_count DESC,provider,status

name: payment_order_provider_status_expired
sql: SELECT id,order_no,status,expired_at FROM payment_orders WHERE provider=:provider AND status=:status AND is_del=2 AND expired_at<=:expired_at ORDER BY expired_at ASC,id ASC LIMIT :limit
row_distribution_sql: SELECT provider,status,is_del,COUNT(*) rows_count FROM payment_orders GROUP BY provider,status,is_del ORDER BY rows_count DESC,provider,status

name: payment_recharge_uncredited
sql: SELECT id,payment_order_id,credited_at FROM payment_recharges WHERE is_del=2 AND credited_at IS NULL AND id>:after_id ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT :limit
row_distribution_sql: SELECT is_del,credited_at IS NULL uncredited,COUNT(*) rows_count FROM payment_recharges GROUP BY is_del,credited_at IS NULL ORDER BY is_del,uncredited

name: notification_user_unread
sql: SELECT id,user_id,is_read,platform FROM notifications WHERE user_id=:user_id AND is_del=2 AND is_read=2 AND platform=:platform AND id<:before_id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT :limit
row_distribution_sql: SELECT platform,is_read,is_del,COUNT(*) rows_count FROM notifications GROUP BY platform,is_read,is_del ORDER BY rows_count DESC,platform,is_read

name: notification_task_due_claim
sql: SELECT id,status,send_at,claim_expires_at FROM notification_task WHERE status=:status AND is_del=2 AND send_at<=:now AND (claim_expires_at IS NULL OR claim_expires_at<=:now) ORDER BY send_at ASC,id ASC LIMIT :limit
row_distribution_sql: SELECT status,is_del,COUNT(*) rows_count FROM notification_task GROUP BY status,is_del ORDER BY status,is_del

name: export_user_platform_active
sql: SELECT id,user_id,platform,status FROM export_tasks WHERE user_id=:user_id AND platform=:platform AND is_del=2 AND id<:before_id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT :limit
row_distribution_sql: SELECT platform,is_del,COUNT(*) rows_count FROM export_tasks GROUP BY platform,is_del ORDER BY platform,is_del

name: cron_task_log_task_active_created
sql: SELECT id,task_id,status,created_at FROM cron_task_log WHERE task_id=:task_id AND is_del=2 AND (created_at<:before_time OR (created_at=:before_time AND id<:before_id)) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT :limit
row_distribution_sql: SELECT task_id,is_del,COUNT(*) rows_count FROM cron_task_log GROUP BY task_id,is_del ORDER BY rows_count DESC,task_id
proposed_index: CREATE INDEX idx_cron_task_log_task_active_created ON cron_task_log (task_id,is_del,created_at DESC,id DESC)
